card: Adds a test case to p2p_sendheaders.py ensuring unconnecting headers do not reset the node's getheaders rate-limit timer. Existing functional tests sent an empty headers message before each unconnecting header, leaving unconnecting headers received in isolation untested. The change closes a test coverage gap from commit 9f66ac7cf1 and kills a known mutant on MutantHub.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the code; diff provided.
evidence: PR description: 'Part 5 of p2p_sendheaders always sends an empty headers message before each unconnecting header, so nothing checked that an unconnecting header on its own leaves m_last_getheaders_timestamp alone.'
PR description notes it kills mutation 'https://mutanthub.space/mutants/3744'.
problem: Existing coverage in p2p_sendheaders always sent an empty headers message before each unconnecting header. This masked whether an unconnecting header received on its own properly avoids resetting m_last_getheaders_timestamp, which was intended by commit 9f66ac7cf1.

risk.why: Touches only functional test logic with no production code changes.

summary: Adds test coverage to p2p_sendheaders.py checking that receiving an unconnecting header without a preceding empty headers message does not reset the peer's getheaders rate-limit timestamp. The test asserts that no immediate getheaders message is sent after an unconnecting header, and that a new getheaders is sent only after mocktime advances past HEADERS_RESPONSE_TIME.
